name: Priya Shah
bio: Priya talks with field technicians and operations leads to decide what Fieldbook should solve next. She turns customer feedback into product priorities and keeps roadmap conversations honest.
responsibilities: Product priorities, customer feature requests, roadmap questions, and deciding what belongs in a future release.
Scoping offline workflow improvements and clarifying which product capabilities are available today.
Reviewing proposed feature commitments with Engineering and Sales. A roadmap item is not a customer promise or a guaranteed delivery date.
